module: Computes the drift score of each tracked vehicle (one score state per vehId). During a drift, adds continuous points to a cached score (distance traveled x angle, speed and wall proximity multipliers, plus a tier bonus), raises a combo (creep-up) through one-sided drifting, drift transitions, cascade zones and close wall passes, and determines the current tier and the performance factor (1 to 4, smoothed). At the end of a drift or chain, the cached score multiplied by the combo is added to the permanent score (wrapUp) then onDriftCompletedScored is emitted.
usage:
local s = gameplay_drift_scoring.getScore()
print(s.score, s.cachedScore, s.combo, s.potentialScore)
-- validate the current score (e.g. end of event):
gameplay_drift_scoring.wrapUp()
notes: Model: potential score = floor(cachedScore * combo). Continuous points are angleMulti * speedMulti * wallMulti * distanceTraveled * continuousDriftPoints (0.6), plus the tier's continuousScore * dtSim; they are multiplied by the stallingSystem factor if it is loaded (Gymkhana mode).
Multipliers: angle from 1 (minAngle) to 10 (maxAngle); speed from 1 to 4 (22 to 200 airSpeed); wall 1 + up to 3 for each front/rear distance.

Combo: starts at 1, +0.1 per 100 of creep-up; slow creep-up ("low" value) beyond the soft cap of 10; hard cap 25. Sources: one-sided drift (angle >= 25°, 10 per 0.1 s, 100 increments max), stunt zone (140), drift transition (100 to 500 depending on speed 30/60/90/120/150, halved beyond the soft cap, minimum speed 25 and 2 s cooldown).

Tiers (minScore of the cached score -> id, continuous bonus/s): 0 drift 10, 250 greatDrift 20, 750 awesomeDrift 30, 2000 superiorDrift 40, 5000 epicDrift 50, 9000 apexDrift 60, 15000 legendaryDrift 75. Names translated via missions.drift.tiers.<id>.

Performance factor: ratio of the frame's continuous score (without tier) to the score of a reference drift (angle 80°, speed 70, rear wall 1.8 m); its "stepped" version (1 to 4) has 0.3 s of hysteresis on tier 4, then is smoothed.
Base points of stunt zones: driftThrough 300, donut 100, hitPole 300, nearPole 300 (basePoints); default points driftThrough 1500, donut 500, hitPole 1000, nearPole 1000.
Score additions are ignored if general drift is frozen, or if the vehicle is individually frozen (setVehicleFrozen). Score updates are skipped when paused or if dtSim <= 0.
Functions without vehId use player 0's vehicle and otherwise any score state; only getScore(vehId) never falls back to another vehicle (it returns an empty score).

Emitted events: onDriftNewCombo({newCombo, comboChange}, vehId), onNewDriftTierReached(tier, vehId), onDriftScoreChanged(driftScore, vehId), onDriftCachedScoreReset(vehId), onDriftScoreWrappedUp(score, vehId), onDriftCompletedScored({addedScore, combo, careerRewards, tier, vehId}), onTightDriftScored / onHitPoleScored / onNearPoleScored / onDonutDriftScored(score, vehId).

getCareerRewardsForDriftScore computes beamXP but always returns an empty table: careerRewards is {} (or nil if score < 300). careerRewards.minScore and scoreMulForXp are therefore unused in practice.
calculatePerformanceFactor can exit without smoothing (return) during the tier 4 hysteresis.

reset.desc: Resets a vehicle's score state (or all vehicles' if vehId is nil) and clears the debug history. Called by gameplay_drift_general.reset.

vehId.desc: Vehicle to reset; nil for all.

getScore.desc: Returns the score table of the requested vehicle, or player 0's if vehId is nil. If the vehicle has no state, returns an empty score.

returns.desc: {score, combo, cachedScore, potentialScore, comboCreepup}. Warning: this is the live table, not a copy.

getDriftPerformanceFactor.desc: Returns the continuous performance factor of the last frame (1 = very good reference drift).

getSteppedDriftPerformanceFactor.desc: Returns the stepped performance factor (1 to 4), smoothed over time.

getScoreAddedThisFrame.desc: Returns the continuous points added during the last frame (tier bonus included).

getCurrentDriftTier.desc: Returns the table of the vehicle's current drift tier (the first one if there is no state).

getDriftTiers.desc: Returns the list of drift tiers (names translated at the first onUpdate).

returns.desc: List of {minScore, continuousScore, id, order, name}.

getScoreOptions.desc: Returns the score settings table (zone points, multipliers, combo options, career rewards). Modifiable at runtime.

getStuntZoneBasePoints.desc: Returns the base points of a stunt zone type.

addCachedScore.desc: Adds points to the cached score (before combo). Ignored if drift is frozen or if the vehicle is frozen. With useStallingSystem, applies the gameplay_drift_stallingSystem factor and rounds down to the integer.

useStallingSystem.desc: true to apply the stalling factor (default false).

wrapUp.desc: Validates the cached score: adds floor(cachedScore * combo) to the permanent score, then resets the cache and the combo to zero (hook onDriftCachedScoreReset). Does nothing if the result is < 1.

returns.desc: Points added, or false if there is nothing to validate.

wrapUpWithText.desc: Like wrapUp, but also emits onDriftScoreWrappedUp(addedScore, vehId) so that the UI displays the validated score.

setVehicleFrozen.desc: Freezes or unfreezes scoring for an individual vehicle (its score additions are then ignored).

isVehicleFrozen.desc: Returns whether this vehicle's scoring is individually frozen.

getDriftDebugInfo.desc: Returns {default=true, canBeChanged=true} for the drift debug window.

getGC.desc: Returns the amount of garbage measured by the profiler.

returns.desc: nil as long as general debug has never been active.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: creates the score states of tracked vehicles, updates tier, performance factor, creep-up and continuous score for each. On the first call, translates the tiers and computes the reference score.

_dtSim.desc: Simulated delta time, used for calculations.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: removes the score state and freeze of the destroyed vehicle.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook: clears all score states and freezes.

onAnyStuntZoneAccomplished.desc: Hook: stunt zone accomplished; raises the combo (creep-up 140, or 20 beyond the soft cap).

onDriftThroughAccomplished.desc: Hook: drift through a zone; score = linearScale(angle, 0..90, 0..zone points) added to the cache with stalling, then hook onTightDriftScored.

onHitPoleAccomplished.desc: Hook: pole hit; score = linearScale(angle + speed, 0..250, 0..points) added to the cache, then hook onHitPoleScored.

onNearPoleAccomplished.desc: Hook: pole nearly hit; score = angle * closeness / 90 * points added to the cache, then hook onNearPoleScored.

onDonutDriftAccomplished.desc: Hook: donut completed; adds the zone's points to the cache, then hook onDonutDriftScored.

onDriftCompleted.desc: Hook: end of a drift chain; validates the score (wrapUp) then emits onDriftCompletedScored with the added score, the combo, the tier and the vehicle.

onDriftTransition.desc: Hook: drift transition (side change); raises the combo according to speed if it exceeds 25 and 2 s have elapsed since the last drift start.

onDriftCrash.desc: Hook: crash; loses the cached score and the combo (cache reset, hook onDriftCachedScoreReset).

onDriftSpinout.desc: Hook: spinout; loses the cached score and the combo.

onDriftPlVehReset.desc: Hook: vehicle put back in place; resets this vehicle's score state.

onDriftChainStarted.desc: Hook: start of a drift chain; emits onNewDriftTierReached with the first tier.

onDriftFreeroamCruisingStarted.desc: Hook: start of cruising in free roam; resets the permanent score of all vehicles to zero.

onSerialize.desc: Hook: saves the debug checkboxes before a Lua reload.
